name: dafny-ipm-vscode
description: Hover over a line of a Dafny {:ipm} proof to see the proof state at that point

dafnyIpm.container.description: Name of the running Docker container that holds the IPM prototype.

dafnyIpm.prototypeDir.description: Folder inside the container that contains dafny-incipm.py.

dafnyIpm.containerMountPath.description: Where the workspace folder is mounted inside the container (docker run -v <workspace>:<this path>).

dafnyIpm.stepTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the prototype to answer one tactic.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node out/test/proofScript.test.js && node out/test/parser.test.js && node out/test/runner.test.js
